mgmt_bio.text: His finance background made him an unusual choice to lead a consumer goods company, where the top job typically goes to brand or sales executives. He has built a leadership team drawn largely from Pepsi, including COO Eric Hanson, a 27-year Pepsi veteran in sales, general management, commercial planning and partnership management, and Celsius International President Garrett Quigley, who spent more than 25 years at Pepsi managing franchise bottler relationships across 120 markets. Under his direction, capital allocation is focused on integrating Alani Nu and Rockstar, paying down acquisition debt, reinvesting in marketing and international expansion, and share buybacks.
